terms.gloss: long sleeves that covered the hands, gloves; here, oven gloves
terms.grammar: plural: a pair of oven gloves
evidence: Plin. Ep. 3.5.15: cujus manūs hieme manicīs mūniēbantur
terms.comment: Classically the long sleeves of a tunic that reached over the hands, and so gloves against the cold: Pliny’s secretary wore them in winter. Their use for oven gloves is modern, and ours. For gloves in general, see “glove”.

phrases.english: Put on the oven gloves; the dish is hot.
Take the dish out of the oven with the oven gloves.

phrases.latin: ad latus notārius cum librō et pugillāribus, cujus manūs hieme manicīs mūniēbantur
phrases.english: at his side a secretary with a book and writing tablets, whose hands in winter were protected by long sleeves
